summary: The FBI is still looking into a suspected break-in at its national crime database, and nobody has said how it happened. US stock futures are bouncing after a very bad week. Delta's flight delays are mostly cleared. No official source links these events.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC for warrant and missing-person checks. Reports do not say if it went down, or if records were copied or changed. Some outlets say the FBI has not commented publicly.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Reports rely on unnamed sources. No attacker named. Nothing links it to the September ShinyHunters jobs-portal breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment systems
events.impact: Farm payment and loan tools were hit last week. I found no new restoration update in today's search.
events.stated_cause: Officials called it a cyberattack. Neither the FBI nor USDA has said who is responsible or what data was taken.

events.title: Delta computer outage delays flights; system back up
events.impact: Delta used manual workarounds and the FAA held Atlanta-bound Delta flights for a while. By 3 a.m. ET Monday most delayed flights had cleared. Counts of delays differ by outlet, from about 1,000 to 1,760.
events.stated_cause: Delta blamed its weight and balance system. The FAA said the delays are not related to air traffic control systems. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: FAA pauses router installs after Nov 13 nationwide ground stop
events.impact: Flights nationwide were stopped for about four hours on Nov 13. As a precaution the FAA paused new Juniper router installs and turned off a feature on over 60 units.
events.stated_cause: Sources differ. CNN says the FAA pointed to an outdated copper wire at a remote site. Newsweek reports the router pause. Whether the two are connected is unclear.

events.title: US stock futures jump after worst week in years
events.impact: Monday morning S&P 500 futures are up about 2.2% and Nasdaq-100 futures about 3%. The Nasdaq fell about 10% last week. South Korea's Kospi fell nearly 4% and officials there announced emergency support steps. Real data, no halts found.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite AI financing worries and Fed rate-hike fears. No technical fault or cyber attack reported.

events.title: Bitcoin steady near 61K USD after dip to about 55.3K
events.impact: Price check: CoinGecko 61,234, OKX 61,225, Coinbase 60,906. Sources agree. Up about 3% in 24h, down 5-7% over 7 days. A recent low near 55,250. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Reports tie the drop to the stock selloff and Fed rate-hike worries.

events.title: Tanker attacks continue near Strait of Hormuz
events.impact: UKMTO reported more tankers hit by unknown projectiles over the weekend, with fires and no casualties reported. Bahrain says Iran hit an industrial site. A joint maritime center rates the threat as severe.
events.stated_cause: No one has officially claimed the projectile hits. Analysts say Iranian involvement is likely. Iran says tankers hit mines; that is unverified.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: Cloudflare's own status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded and Amsterdam under maintenance. A small vendor reported a minor issue tied to a Brussels location. No wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and Apache Roller. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the USDA or FBI incidents.

events.title: Microsoft explains Nov 12 global Microsoft 365 outage
events.impact: Outlook, Exchange Online, Teams and Copilot were disrupted for almost 24 hours. Microsoft published its full explanation Saturday.
events.stated_cause: Microsoft says a months-old software bug was triggered after Teams traffic moved to servers with less capacity. It says it was not a cyberattack.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The FBI and USDA breaches have no named cause or attacker. Delta blamed its own weight and balance system, and the FAA says it was not an air traffic issue. The market drop is tied to AI and rate worries. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: No confirmed link between incidents and no new major system failure in the last two hours.

prep_note: No action needed for most people. If you rely on farm payments or police records systems, check for agency notices. Travelers should check airline apps before leaving. Keep some cash and do not act on social media crash claims; check real price data first.
